verdict.rationale: Ramp documents real-time QuickBooks sync of accounting fields, transactions, reimbursements and bills, with a built-in reconciliation tool. It has dedicated NetSuite and Xero integration pages, single-step multi-entity sync, and automatic coding of receipts to the correct GL account. Accounting categories, tracking categories and departments are exposed as manageable data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-controlled GL/class/department mapping rules, explicit card-transaction sync for NetSuite and Xero (their pages only describe bill flows), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
